gates.title: Forsetti compliance architecture
gates.acceptance: Task contract/profile/public API/module/dependency decisions pass.

gates.title: Build scaffold
gates.acceptance: Canonical Debug and Release x64 scaffold builds.

gates.title: Domain/contracts
gates.acceptance: Domain and interface tests pass with no platform leakage.

gates.title: Infrastructure ownership

gates.title: Database/migrations

gates.title: Native tools

gates.title: MCP protocol

gates.title: UI parity/accessibility

gates.title: Security

gates.title: macOS import
gates.acceptance: Dry-run, transactional import, rollback, idempotency, and corruption tests pass.

gates.title: Installer lifecycle
gates.acceptance: Fresh install, launch, startup, repair, update, uninstall, reinstall, purge pass.

gates.title: Full tests/analyzers
gates.acceptance: All native suites and applicable analyzers pass.

gates.title: Resource/endurance
gates.acceptance: Budgets and one-hour/lifecycle stress pass with no monotonic leak.

gates.title: Complete feature parity
